P10_design_small.go: variance removed by best 5 / random 5 >= 1.25 (mean over replicates)
P10_design_small.no_go: recommendation 2 is likely at full scale; continue, as the race still teaches
P10_design_small.rules: best 5 = greedy variance removal; random 5 = mean over 50 random 5-site sets; gap 5 = greedy farthest launch site from every 2025 network profile and every chosen site
P10_design_small.what: SMALL crop at the P6 MAP: condition on 2024 crop profiles of training floats and on the positions of 2025 crop profiles (the network); target = 2 degree ocean cells of the crop x 4 times in 2025 (15 Feb, May, Aug, Nov), latent anomaly variance; 40 candidate sites on a fixed grid, each a float launched on a day drawn from 1-60 Jan 2025 and drifting by a real 36-cycle track (bootstrapped by region), 4 drift replicates common to all rules (seed 10)

P8_vecchia.go: |exact - Vecchia| / n < 0.005 nats per observation at m = 30
P8_vecchia.no_go: C uses m = 60; if m = 60 is also over, C is reported as an approximation with the measured gap
P8_vecchia.what: SMALL crop, 2024, the first 3,000 of a fixed shuffle (seed 8) of training floats' profiles, at the P6 MAP (Matern 1/2, Mercator); maxmin ordering and nearest previous neighbours in the metric (dx/lx1, dy/ly1, dt/lt1); response Vecchia (nugget inside each conditional); m = 15, 30, 60 against the exact log likelihood

data.coords: Mercator km, t in days from 2023-01-01; kernel Matern 1/2, two scales, nugget, marginalised intercept and trend (P6)
data.fingerprint: table SHA-256 must equal the registry file's; else stop
data.test: the held-out floats' 2023-2024 profiles (expected 43 floats, 2,116 profiles); their 2025 profiles are used only by the natural experiment
data.train: 2023-2024 rows of argo_natl_t100 whose float is not held out by e92_core.holdout (10% of floats by a fixed hash): expected n = 23,939

design.decision_model: the exact model (A, A_fix, A_fix_t) with the best mean per-float CRPS
design.recommendation: 2 (fill the gaps) if greedy / gap-filling variance removed < 1.10 under the decision model; else 1 (target these sites) if the recommended 20 of A and A_fix share at least 10 sites; else 3 (target a region) if their picks by region (3 latitude bands 20-32-44-55N x 2 halves at 40W) differ by total variation under 0.25; else 2
design.recommended_20: the 20 sites picked most often over draws x replicates under the decision model
design.rules: greedy variance removal; gap-filling (greedy farthest from network and chosen sites); random (mean of 50 sets)
design.variants: at the mode: target weight on the Gulf Stream box only; fixed sites (36 cycles at the launch point); how many of the top 20 change is reported
design.what: condition on training profiles and on positions of 2025 profiles of non-held floats (the network); target = 2 degree ocean cells (open_atlantic at the centre, climatology defined) x 15 Feb, May, Aug, Nov 2025, latent anomaly variance, equal weight; 200 candidate sites (a fixed quasi-uniform set of ocean points, seed 92); each float launched on a day drawn from 1-60 Jan 2025, 36 cycles of 10 days kept inside 2025 and inside the ocean, tracks bootstrapped from real 2023-2024 tracks starting within 600 km (else the 20 nearest); 4 drift replicates, common to every rule (seed 92); 20 picks

failure_runs.line: none; a demonstration. 'Silently wrong' = f32 Cholesky finite and |log det error| > 1 nat
failure_runs.what: ExpQuad 1,500 km, 1,000 km, 200 d plus nugget at signal/nugget ratio 1e3, 1e4, 1e5 on n = 5,000, 10,000, 20,000 training locations (fixed shuffle seed 0): f32 against f64 log determinant and log density on the GPU; lambda_max by 30 power iterations; and Matern 1/2 at A's mode at the full n in f32 against f64

fit_A.edge_action: if any sits outside: A is kept and scored at its mode with the edge printed; the tails fix runs next (A-t: Student-t nugget, nu = 4 fixed, by scale-mixture weights updated from the exact posterior of each residual, then theta refitted, 8 rounds, warm start). If A-t's mode is inside every edge, A-t replaces A for the Hessian, the Sobol points and the design; otherwise A is used, and its Laplace sd on the edge coordinate is flagged as unreliable. No other fix is tried
fit_A.edges: every hyperparameter inside its prior's 1%-99% quantiles (log scale; c: Normal(0, 5))
fit_A.optimiser: own L-BFGS (memory 10, Armijo backtracking, pair kept only if s.y > 1e-10), every evaluation checkpointed; phase 1 GPU f32 until max|g| < 1.0 or 3 iterations in a row with relative change < 1e-8 or 60 iterations; phase 2 GPU f64 (preallocated pool) from the phase 1 point with fresh memory until max|g| < 0.02 or 25 evaluations

hessian.no_go: step 1e-3 once; then clip eigenvalues at 1e-6 of the largest and say so
hessian.what: central differences of the f64 hand gradient, step 1e-4, symmetrised

natural_experiment.go: realised > 0 and the 90% float-bootstrap interval of realised minus predicted contains 0
natural_experiment.what: at A's mode (fit to 2023-2024), map the held-out floats' 2025 profiles with all 2025 profiles of non-held floats, and without the floats launched in 2025 (no 2023-2024 rows and first 2025 cycle <= 1); predicted reduction = mean predictive variance without minus with; realised = mean squared error without minus with

plan: plans/large/E92.md, 'FULL rung: decided 2026-11-03', 'Failure and fix', 'Checkpoint stages'

pymc_audit.go: log-hyperparameter means within 0.5 posterior sd; Laplace / NUTS sd ratio 0.7-1.3; max r_hat <= 1.01
pymc_audit.no_go: importance sampling from NUTS replaces Laplace for the audit at n = 2,000, and the notebook says the full-scale uncertainty is approximate on the failing coordinates
pymc_audit.what: SMALL crop 2024, first n of the seed 7 shuffle (as at n = 400), n = 800 and 2,000; nutpie, 4 chains as 4 processes on cores 2-5, one BLAS thread each, 1,000 tune + 1,000 draws, seeds 920-923; Laplace at the hand model's mode on the same subset

racers.A: exact stationary GP at the mode (or A-t, by fit_A's edge action)
racers.A_fix: exact, K = D R D + nugget + trend: D at each point = exp of the 500 km Gaussian-weighted mean of log local signal sd sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2) over B's windows, normalised to geometric mean 1 over training points; global theta refitted from A's mode as fit_A
racers.A_fix_t: if tails demand it (below): A_fix with the Student-t nugget as in fit_A's edge action
racers.B: local GPs: window centres every 4 degrees lat (22-54N) and 8 degrees lon (76W-4W); training profiles within 1,000 km, the nearest 4,000 if more; windows with under 800 dropped; each its own MAP from A's mode, GPU f64; a held-out float is predicted by the window nearest its centroid
racers.C: Vecchia, m = 30 (60 if P8 fails), A's kernel, own MAP; neighbours from A's scales, refreshed once from C's own; a held-out float is conditioned on the union of each profile's m nearest

safety: before each job and each chunk: /sys/devices/system/cpu/offline == '10,26' and the kernel log's machine-check count == 1; a detached watcher kills every E92 job on any change

scores.A_fix_target: 90% coverage in the Gulf Stream box >= 85%
scores.failure_1: symptom present if A's 90% coverage over held-out profiles in the Gulf Stream box is below 80% while coverage in the gyre is above 90%; reported in full either way
scores.per_profile: Gaussian predictive (latent + nugget) CRPS in closed form; 90% central interval; z = (y - mean) / sd. Student-t models: CRPS and interval by 4,000 Monte Carlo draws (seed 92). Per float: mean CRPS of its profiles; joint Gaussian log score where Gaussian
scores.rule: A beats a rival only if the 90% interval of the paired whole-float bootstrap (4,000 resamples, seed 92) of mean per-float CRPS (rival minus A) excludes zero; over all held-out floats and inside the Gulf Stream box separately
scores.tails_demand_t: more than 1% of held-out profiles with |z| > 3 under A_fix (Gaussian: 0.27%)

sobol_A.draws: design draw 0 = the mode; draws 1-10 by systematic resampling (seed 92) of the PSIS weights; if k >= 0.7, draws 1-10 are the first 10 Sobol points unweighted, flagged
sobol_A.what: 64 scrambled Sobol points (seed 92) of the Gaussian approximation, f64 log density, PSIS weights
